name: Kikou Juu Yuushi Sakigake
source:
22nd century. Global self-defense organization "the Outer Space Defense Force" is launched. 
Main character is its officer. He leads a happy yet slightly boring everyday life, but everything changes with the assault of unidentified "Seeker". By chance he takes command over battleship and starts his crusade.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
22世纪。全球自卫组织“外太空防卫军”成立。
主角是该组织的一名军官。他过着幸福却略显无聊的日常，但一切因身份不明的“Seeker”袭击而改变。一次偶然机会，他接管了一艘战舰，踏上征讨之路。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
